speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to help determine the cause, have these symptoms been present for more than a week, and have you experienced any seizures or vision changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The combination of a pregnant patient presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise, specifically with a history of consuming unpasteurized dairy products like ice cream, is highly suggestive of Listeriosis. This condition can lead to serious complications such as sepsis or neonatal infection and requires immediate antibiotic treatment.
